nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream Dark Circle Corrector

avis.texte: Have tried many times to write this (perhaps 1-star generates 'try again later' reactions on the product, chuckle), but seriously: made dark circles worse. Given the cost, and beand, its a rarr fail.
This is a lovely fast absorbing cream. I can see the difference after a few weeks,I use it under make up as well and it sits well under it
i've seen a slight light improvement on my dark circles but it has only been a few weeks

Ive been using this product day and night for 5 weeks straight, I see no difference with my dark circles. I do like this has no smell and no irritation for me. But didnt help at all. For the amount of product and price I wouldn't recommend.

I would say that it took about 3 weeks for me to really notice, but yes, my dark circles were much improved! it made me feel like I could have more "makeup optional"days vs feeling like I needed to at least wear concealer because of them. the only thing is, I definitely don't find this as moisturizing as I would have liked. in fact, since using this eye cream, now I've noticed fine lines that are cracking my concealer. so I have been looking to perhaps later this circle-banishing magic underneath something more hydrating.

I bought this because the LRP undereye formula was surprisingly irritating. Unfortunately this product is irritating as well, just not as much. I have been using it for a month, but I dont see a difference and it stings my sensitive skin, so I'm back in the search game.
I've been trying this for about a month and unfortunately I haven't seen any difference. It also irritates my skin every other day, so I decided to stop using it.

I don't have crazy dark circles but I decided to give this a try. With just two weeks of use, I did not see any progress. But I have noticed that I started to get milia around my eyes. I have since stopped using it.
I have really dark circles and dry skin under my eyes. This is one of the few products that takes care of both. Lots of other products bother my eyes. This one does not.
This works for all around the eye area and fades the Dark circles. It takes few weeks to see results but it works .

As a girly with hereditary dark circles, this does wonders!!! I've seen such a difference overtime. I've used so many dark circle eye creams and none of them compare to this. It pills if you put too much but honestly I deal with the pilling and reapply because it's just that good.

I have only been using the product for 2 weeks, but i have already noticed an improvement. I suffer from dark under eyes and no concealer ive found has covered them up fully. So i thought id try this corrector since the reviews were positive. Im very pleased with how my undereyes look since using this. The only concern i have was that the first fee times i used it, it burned a little. But now it doesnt. Ill update my review with pics once i use it a little longer!

I wanted to love this because it feels nice going on, is gently illuminating, and most importantly doesn't burn like so many illuminating undereye creams. unfortunately it is very prone to pilling. it was extremely incompatable with the sunscreen I was using when I first got it, and did improve when I went back to my favorite sunscreen but still pills up a bit throughout the day if I wipe or rub the area around the eye at all. I decided not to return it because I otherwise do enjoy using it, but will not be repurchasing and wouldn't reccommend it to others.

I really wanted to love this as I was searching for something to replace the discontinued Hope in a Tube. While it was somewhat moisturizing and somewhat "illuminating" it "pills" when you touch it rind the area where it was applied.
I seriously look 10 yrs younger. No more puffiness or dark circles. Thank you Eucerin!
Kept my skin feeling hydrated all day long. I would recommend for anyone with dry skin.

avis.titre: Eye Cream support for dark circles
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my review. This product was a new introduction for me but the brand has been one that I rely on for skin care to improve dryness. Eucerin is a brand I trust and was excited to try. The creamy consistency blends in well to your skin and the applicator feels so cooling on your skin. I love that thoughtful addition to the packaging. You can control how much product you need by a simple squeeze. There is a light color to the cream that helps lighten your dark circles. This product will last about 2-3 months with daily use. The price point is unbeatable for a product like this compared to luxury brands and works just as well if not better!

This eye cream feels so luxurious going on. It absorbs quickly without a greasy residue, which is a huge plus. I've noticed my dark circles seem a little less intense after using it for a while. The fine lines around my eyes also appear softer. Plus, the subtle fragrance is really pleasant.
This product was easy to use and apply. I truly recommend it.
Nice new product from a trusted brand. Happy to see them expand

This eye cream is very moisturizing and made my dark under eye circles look much brighter. It also helps with wrinkles and anti aging. It absorbs really nicely it o your skin and isn't greasy either. Amazing if you're trying to prevent aging or the look of under eye circles.
I got this eye cream for free in exchange for my honest review. I really like it. It brightens up my eyes.

I received this complementary product as an exchange for my honest opinion. I really like the tip used for this eye cream because it makes it easier to apply it's easy to glide without being harsh with the under eye skin. I enjoyed the glow my skin had after applying this cream and I would recommend this product for anyone looking for something that will give a smooth, dewy, and refreshing look and feel to the under eyes .
While I've not used the product long enough to see long term change of my dark under eyes, I will way the cream is moisturizing and cooling. Love the metal does foot tip for applying the product.

avis.titre: Wonderful tube of creamy lightweight lightning lotion.
avis.texte: I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream for free, and let me just say—this little tube is magic! After using it, I noticed a definite brightening to the dark circles under my eyes, making me look way more awake (even when I'm running on fumes). It feels lightweight, absorbs beautifully, and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Honestly, it works so well that I'm already planning to purchase it myself. Consider me officially obsessed!

I received a sample of this whole body deodorant for my honest review. I love that this product is easy to apply and works by reducing my dark under eye areas. Hopefully with continued use long term my under eyes will be free from dark circles.
Received as a free product. I have to say it t leaves my skin feeling soft and Fresh. I can really feel the difference in cleaning.

I recieved this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. Overall, im not impressed. I have been loving Eucerin skincare products lately but this one was underwhelming. The texture of the cream is nice and the applicator appeared useful. However, the applicator was nice except i felt like it just spreads the cream around. It was very hard to get it to absorb into my skin. The tint is nice and i felt like it made my skin a bit brighter. Overall, its an okay product but i wont be purchasing in the future.
I absolutely love how well this has worked for me. I got this product as a free sample and I'm happy I did. Recommend going out and buying this product..

This eye cream has great packaging and the application is easy. After using this for a few weeks, I can see a difference in my under eyes and I have naturally veiny eyelids so I put it on them at night and it has brightened my eyes.

My husband has been using it for the past few weeks and says he liked it. He said texture is good a doesn't make him feel oily or sticky. His face is more hydrated. So far we haven't seen the effects but it seems to work just in a longer time
This product is too good, if used correctly and daily you see the results
Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream is a fantastic product that actually works to decrease the look of eye puffiness and bags and reduce the look of tired eyes.

avis.titre: Eucerin eye cream i think was not bad
avis.texte: i had a little bit of higher hopes for this Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream! It wasn't a bad product though! It had a nice, lightweight feel to it! I liked the way the applicator was also! And, how it was cool on the under of my eyes! It definitely did relieve my eyes of dark circles somewhat! i didn't have as dark of dark circles as i usually do after using this Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream! Overall, i would say it was a good product! i would definitely use again and would purchase in the future as long as the price is right!(not too expensive! i'm on a budget!)
The applicator feels so refreshing and the rose tone of the product looks so natural and makes my under eyes look glowy and well rested.

I Love the eye cream and the fact that the texture absorbs nices and is not greasy. The packaging is nice, as it's a nice smell tube and easy to get the cream out of the applicator. I've noticed a change of color under my eyes and there's little puffiness. Highly recommend and will purchase more in the future.

I've been using this product daily for about 10 days, and all I can say is "WOW!" I have had horrible dark circles under my eyes since I was in my 20s due to genetics. I've never found a cream that would make any kind of difference. From the first time I used this, I was in awe. It starts working right away and lasts all day. It slowly lessened my dark circles and boosts it every morning when I apply it. I LOVE IT!
This product was received for free by pinchme! I liked it okay. It applied nicely, but I don't think it works better than my current product. Still would recommend over some other brands, though!

I have tried sooooo many eye creams. I have yet to find one I like that hydrates my eyes and helps dark circles. I am beyond impressed with this one and will repurchase it again and again. It is AMAZING.
What a great eye cream. Not only does it hydrate my under eyes, but it brightens and makes them appear more radiant, which reduces the look of my dark circles. Makeup layers nicely over it, as well!
I received this as a free sample, I've been using this daily and I'm not sure if I notice any difference, but it feels hydrating.
I love the applicator it allows for precision applying and my dark circles and eye puffiness is looking soo much better after just a week of regular use ! It's a must have eye cream!
I absolutely loved this product made my skin feel so soft snd refreshed

I received the Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream for free in exchange of my honest review, the Eucerin have plenty of good products that work really well with with almost every skin type the skin feels soft after using it for al least a week, is easy to apply and the applicator looks very nice and it feels good on the skin.
I loved my free sample I received of the Eucerin eye cream. It really helped minimize the appearance of my dark circles
It left my skin glowing and I feel like it helped with my under eye darkness. It was easy to apply and didn't leave any residue
This Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream is great and it goes on smoothly and it really works a great product.

I loved this eye cream. I just can't believe I didn't try it earlier! Love that it's easy to get the product out of the tube, but it glides on smoothly too. It absorbs well! Can't wait to go buy another once I run out of the one I have.

The Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream is comfortable when applied, This applicator can make the process feel soothing and prevent tugging, which is important, especially for wrinkle-prone skin. I've seen a noticeable benefits over time.
Good cream. Good brand too. Helps the skin a great deal. Tried it free.
I've only been using it for a few days but I think it's decent so far. It is slightly brightening when you put it on and the metal applicator is cooling.

I love this product its an all around great product i seen results in the first couple times i applied this product under my eyes. I love the metal tip at the end to apply this it feels nice and cold i feel that helps reduce puffyness. I tried to add my photos but every time its deleted what i wrote amd still would not save photo of product. But i definitely would recommend this eye cream great stuff all around.
I received a free sample from pinchme for eucerin radiant tone eye cream. I would recommend. It seemed to work fairly well with no allergies.
I enjoyed this eye cream, it had a nice consistency and was hydrating for my under eye area. Helped with dark circles, as well.

I received this product from PINCHme in exchange for my honest review. I was pleasantly surprised with this product. It works really well, is non greasy, and easy to apply. I will definitely be purchasing this once I am finished with the tube I received. It helps calm my puffy eyes and helps with dark circles.
This product was amazing I like the feeling to it when applying it it's not sticky it helped my dark circles
I thought this was a great eye cream. I received this product for free. I already am a eucerin user and lover so I had high hopes for this product and they were met.

This is hydrating but I did not notice a big difference in the appearance of my dark circles. I think maybe with time this will work but I have only used it twice and did not notice a difference. The texture is creamy and I do like the applicator because it is metal it has a nice cooling effect. I will keep trying this for a few weeks and see if i notice a difference. But I do like how hydrating it is.

I usually have problems with face products making my skin oily even though my skin acts dry after I wash it. But this didn't do that at all! My undereyes are especially dry, definitely noticing signs of aging there. Lightened up dark areas I'm getting as my skin is aging. Seeing results only 2 weeks in but I'm excited to continue using this product! I received this product free as part of a promotion,but I'll definitely continue to purchase it !!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product smells great. It feels amazing on the skin. I can start to see a difference under my eyes. I would definitely recommend this product.
After a few weeks I definitely notice an improvement, bought some more

This eye cream is very gentle and hydrating! I have somewhat sensitive skin, and several eye creams have caused break outs in the past, but this one did not at all. It did improve the look of my fine lines and dark circles. It is fragrance-free and worked well for my sensitive skin. Overall, I'd definitely recommend it!
I recieved a full size sample in the mail. Small tube packed in a box. Directions printed on the box. Doesn't smell Parfums. Soothing metal applicator tip feels nice.

The design of this product is great for application. I love the shape that curves for the under eye area. It has a brownish color but blends in clear. My under eye area seems less dull after use. I haven't noticed an improvement in age spots but I'm still going to see after more time using the product.

I tried it the first time and, I could feel it working immediately. I got this as a full size product sample from pinch-me but, I use it atleast every night. It's definitely a great product for the price. I use everyday form of social media and leave thoughtful reviews to make sure people aren't being taken advantage of. I hope you love this product as much as I have.

I enjoyed my trial of the Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream. I typically have slight dark circles under my eyes daily, with a little puffiness in the mornings. I used this product both morning and night. It glides on really smoothly, with no stickiness or off-putting texture. The metal applicator tip provides a cooling sensation, which can also help calm puffiness. I have noticed after using it for two weeks that my under eye circles have definitely brightened.

I've only been using the eye cream for about a week now, but I've been loving it! The metal applicator (especially in the morning) feels so cooling on my skin, it's refreshing! I was surprised to see that the formula looked tinted when you squeeze it out, but not to worry, it dries down completely clear! If I were to change one thing about this product, I would make it so that the metal applicator was a bit rounder, closer to like a ball shape! The flat applicator isn't much of a bother, but the product would glide on smoother if it were rounder!
Loving this eye cream by Eucerin! I already love their body products, and this cream didn't disappoint! Rich and hydrating, very effective!

avis.titre: A Brightening Eye Cream Life Saver!
avis.texte: I'm impressed with the Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream, which I received for free. This rich and non-greasy eye cream has become a staple in my daily skincare routine, providing noticeable brightening and hydrating effects. After consistent use, I observed a reduction in the appearance of fine lines and dark circles, leaving my under-eye area looking smoother and more radiant. While individual results may vary, I'm pleased with the noticeable improvements this eye cream has brought to my skin. Overall, I'd highly recommend this product to those seeking a reliable and effective eye cream for a brighter, more youthful appearance.

I received the Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream as part of a sampling program. The eye cream makes the dark circles around my eyes disappear quickly. The cream doesn't irritate my skin as other products do. I highly recommend this product for its effectiveness.
This stuff is unbelievable! As soon as I applied this my eyes were instantly brightened, blurring fine lines, uneven skin, and smooths and hydrates! I'd recommend you try this forsure!!!

I love that this product has a light tint to it that helps even out any dark circles or bags under my eyes, leaving me looking brighter and well rested! It has a smooth application and doesn't interfere with other products in my makeup routine!
This cream is really good. My eyes have reduced the circles and they make my face look younger

This eye cream surprised me. It's actually very soothing and works well for any puffiness under the eyes, and hydrates great! I'm grateful for getting to try it, and will absolutely recommend to others!
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I was really excited to try this product because i love the brand. I really like how it made my skin look after a couple day.

This eye cream works really well. It provides hydration to the skin around the eyes and can be applied easily with the application store. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle, effective eye cream.

I loved the way this eye cream felt as I applied it. The metal applicator is nice and cool! I didn't see noticeable results with this product but it could be due to the fact it isn't meant to show results after a few usages. I did forget to use this product some days. I would recommend this product. I got my free sample on PinchMe. .

I received a tube of this on Pinch me in exchange for review, but I lost my first tube and I'm buying another one right now because I loved it so much. This is my honest review. At night I put a fairly thick layer under my eyes and after about half an hour it's already absorbed into the skin. I do the same in the morning but less thick During my morning prep routine. It has made a world of a difference honestly. It's my first eye treatment experience and I was amazed by results within a day. So many of the free trial reviews are fake positive but seriously it works for me so well.
Good eye cream that absorbs quickly. Has a slight shimmer to instantly brighten up the eye.

avis.titre: Not for me, but please try for yourself! Not bad.
avis.texte: I received this product for free. It's not as good as I'd hoped it would be, but that shouldn't dissuade someone from purchasing, because I've never found an eye product that works well on my dark circles. I've tried many, but I'm pretty sure my dark circles are here to stay! The good news is, it's very lightweight and there's no scent. I think it would be a good product for even people who have sensitive skin to try. It's quite affordable, as well.

Received this product for free from PinchMe. This is very good eye cream. I've been using it and already see an improvement. The cream instantly brightens the eye area and has a cool feeling metal applicator that helps to reduce puffiness. The cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly and doesn't feel greasy.
This free sample was too potent. It had a burning sensation for a minute or 2 after applying. I did find the tube and applicator tip easy to use and spread the product thought so that was great
Smooth application and feels nice and cooling with the applicator tip. I can see the slight brightening effect immediately after use the area is more radiant and will see how it does over time.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The eye cream has a great rich texture, immediately fills in the fine wrinkles around my eyes and brightens. I am very pleased with it and looking forward for even better results after a longer time of use.
I received a free sample of Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream in exchange for my honest feedback. I love this eye cream. It hydrates while making my eyes look brighter and less puffy.

avis.titre: Gave my under eyes some new life
avis.texte: I'm a tired first time mom to an 8 month old and I've definitely gotten less sleep, causing some dark circles under my eyes. Using this product showed some pretty noticeable difference after the first use. My under eyes seemed slightly brighter and looked a little more lively under my makeup. The texture of the product is a little thicker than I expected but not a huge problem. I received this product as a gift from the manufacturer.

I have sensitive skin and am always nervous about trying new products, especially around my eyes, but I had no issues using this eye cream! I love the applicator and how cooling it is. I have always had dark circles and this product has definitely brightened under my eyes, it's hydrating and most importantly has not irritated my skin at all. I'm excited to keep using it!

The Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream is a lightweight yet hydrating formula that feels soothing on the delicate under-eye area. It absorbs quickly and works well under makeup without causing creasing or irritation. After consistent use, I noticed a subtle brightening effect and a smoother appearance around my eyes. While dark circles won't disappear overnight, this cream provides gentle hydration and a refreshed look over time. I received this product for free and appreciate the chance to try it—worth considering if you're looking for a brightening eye cream!

I immediately saw a difference after using the Eucerin Radiant Tone eye cream for a few days. The dark circles under my eyes have been looking brighter. I don't feel as I need to use as much concealer now. Definitely recommend this product! received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
This eye cream is really good for the price. The applicator is cooling.
This product is not hypoallergenic. I immediately got a burning sensation once I used it. The texture was creamy and melted in my skin easily. There was hardly a smell to it. Packaging was great.

I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream free from PinchMe in exchange for my honest opinion. I am happy to report that this might be a game changer. I've only been using about a week and I love the formula especially the metal top applicator and how well it feels on my tired eyes. I have noticed reduced black circles around my eyes faintly within this week and I believe with continued use they will reduce more. Thanks

I recieved this product in exchange for my honest review. I did not feel this performed any different than other comparable brands I have tried. I did like the application however. Perhaps I just need to use it longer to notice a change. I do plan to keep using it to see if my opinion changes.
Feels good and makes eyes less puffy. Really easy to use. Used it in the morning and night. Would recommend.
I love Eucerin products and now they have a eye cream, I'm in love
I love this product. It helps with the dark circles and puffiness around my eyes. Amazing making me look young and radiant.

I received this eye cream in exchange for my honest review. I absolutely love this eye cream. It really helps to reduce the puffiness in my eyes. It makes them look brighter and moisturized. I totally recommend.
The product works well. I think I like my current product better. But if I run out of my current product, and need a quick replacement, I would use this

avis.titre: Get a radiant tone at an affair price
avis.texte: I'd recommend the Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream to anyone looking for a gentle, effective product to brighten and tone the delicate skin around the eyes. It's affordable, reliable, and doesn't disappoint.

Inliked the packaging - comfortable to hold and good that the top screws on. The cream has a slight color and shimmer, hence giving the effect of fresh look, covering datk circles. Wasn't crazy about metal tip - it pulls sking unless the whole thing is covered with cream. But that doesn't happen if you dispense desired amount. Had to use my fingers.

After receiving a free sample of Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream from pinchMe. I tried it as soon as I could. The coolness of the application tip felt amazing as I slid it under my eye. I was able to tell exactly where I was using it, and it blended in smoothly. I could tell a big difference by the 3rd time I used it. I look well rested even when I'm not. Definitely love this.
I received a free sample of Eucerin eye tone cream from pinchme. I wasn't a fan of the color of the cream. It seemed like it made my eyes puffy. I stopped right away.

The Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream was a nice, thick eye cream. I used it daily (at night before bed) and it seemed to do a good job of moisturizing the skin under my eyes. It didn't have an overwhelming smell, it wasn't sticky and seemed to absorb well but still seem to be effective. I would recommend. NOTE: I received a free sample in exchange for my honest review.

I'm not sure if I really see a difference using this eye cream, but the texture of the cream was nice and the packaging nice even though I didn't think the applicator applied as well as I'd hope. I enjoyed feeling the "tingle" and hope that with longer term use, I will be able to see more of a change.

The product itself seems good, but in terms of what it's supposed to do I didn't really see that much change. The product packaging is nice, and instructions are easy to follow. Product feels fine on my skin and doesn't really have a smell to it. My only complaint is for me it didn't really improve my under eye area really.

I have been using the Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream free sample I received for a few weeks now, and I really like it. It's very easy to apply and blends into my skin quickly. It does reduce my puffy eyes and dark circles. A very nice product!

Love how lightweight it is, absorbs quickly, not sticky/greasy/tacky, dries with a smooth to touch feel with no pilling. But the little glitter flecks are silly looking and is a cheap way for the brand to say it will make your skin "glow" by reflecting light…it's literally just flecks of sparkles, not actually healthy glowing skin. It did nothing for the pigmentation. My fine lines look exactly the same. It's not the most hydrating either.
This Eucerin Radiant Tone Eye Cream is a very good eye cream and it definitely gets the job done!!
Firstly, I really love the metal applicator on this product. It stays really cold and feels so nice under the eyes. The cream itself is really nice as well

I am loving this eye cream. I cannot wait to see the even toning results once I continue to use the cream. The eye cream applies really well and is moisturizing. The dispenser is great and allows for a even application.
Received this free. Good for sensitive skin. Need to use finger to blend fully. Hydrating.
